summary: Case ho-06 (f.yildiz@aegean.edu) is assessed as benign with 0.85 confidence. Two claims were rejected by the Critic: alleged bulk SIS access from 193.140.10.21 failed an independent recount (461 vs 100 events, outside tolerance), and reported password spray followed by successful sign-in was attributed to shared egress, with 202 distinct accounts completing MFA from that IP in 30 days. No compromise signal survived.

rejected_claims.reason: critic: 193.140.10.21 looks like shared egress: 202 distinct accounts completed MFA from this IP in the last 30 days (threshold 10); failures across many accounts are expected background noise, not a coordinated spray

risk.rationale: No surviving/verified findings exist for ho-06. Both suspicious claims were independently rejected: (1) the alleged 100 SIS successes from 193.140.10.21 fails verification (recount yields 461, outside the 10% tolerance); (2) the alleged password-spray-then-success chain is explained away because 193.140.10.21 is shared egress with 202 distinct accounts completing MFA from it in 30 days (far above the threshold of 10), making cross-account failures consistent background noise rather than a coordinated spray. With no confirmed account-takeover chain and all signals explained, this is benign.
